content.short: P-Link simplifies Solana payment requests by enabling instant, no-code, subscription-free links.
content.description: P-Link brings Solana payments to a simple, code-free workflow. Create instant transactions with or without NFTs, and have wallets automatically generated and linked to each user’s email. Connects directly to websites, social channels, and automation tools like Zapier, making it easy to embed payment flows anywhere. Customize payment pages to match your brand or campaign, and automate routine tasks through RSS-driven triggers. Perfect for gifts, product launches, and streamlined sales processes.
content.meta: P-Link streamlines Solana payments, enabling instant, no-code transactions. Discover P-Link and other Web3 Wallet Tools on Lancers Web3 Explorer.
